Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: ioni-ist: Schematic diagram, not to scale: an ion implanter. At the bottom left is the ion source, from which the ions are accelerated by a voltage U between two grid electrodes. The ions then travel horizontally to the right between the two horizontal plates of the velocity selector, which are a distance d apart. The polarity of the plates is not marked. In the selector there is a magnetic field B s into the page. On the right, in the chamber of the analysing magnet, there is a magnetic field B into the page. In it the ion beam curves in a semicircle of radius r, upwards and back to the left, and passes through a slit in the left wall of the chamber to the silicon wafer, which is above the selector.
Kaavakuva nopeusvalitsimesta: ylempi lev: Schematic diagram of the velocity selector: the upper plate is positive and the lower negative, so the electric field E points downwards between the plates. The magnetic field points into the page, shown by the green crosses. Between the plates there is a positive ion whose velocity v points to the right. The ion is acted on by a magnetic force F m upwards and an electric force F s downwards. The force arrows are equally long, because the forces on an ion travelling straight cancel each other.
Kuvaaja: napadynamon jännite u ajan t fu: Graph: the voltage u of the hub dynamo as a function of time t over the interval 0–90 ms, with the light off. The voltage varies sinusoidally. It starts from zero and rises to a peak value of 14 V at 7.5 ms, falls to minus 14 V at 22.5 ms and returns to zero at 30 ms. The same variation is repeated three times. The vertical grid lines are at 5 ms intervals and the horizontal ones at 2 V intervals.
Kuvaaja: kuuman teräsaihion lähettämän s: Graph: the relative intensity of the radiation emitted by a hot steel slab as a function of the wavelength lambda over the range 0–6 micrometres. The curve rises steeply from about 0.7 micrometres, reaches its peak and then falls gently. The peak is on the vertical grid line at 2.0 micrometres. The range of visible light, 0.38–0.75 micrometres, is shaded; there the curve is almost at zero. The vertical grid lines are at 0.5 micrometre intervals.
Kaavakuva, kulmat liioiteltuja: valokuid: Schematic diagram, angles exaggerated: the end of an optical fibre seen from the side. In the middle is the core, with refractive index n 1, and above and below it the cladding, with refractive index n 2. On the left is air. A ray comes from the air to the end face of the fibre at an angle theta to the normal of the end face and is refracted in the core to an angle beta. The ray strikes the interface between the core and the cladding at an angle alpha r to the normal of the interface and is totally reflected back into the core. The angles beta and alpha r together make 90 degrees.
Kuvaaja: maksimin suunnan sini sin theet: Graph: the sine of the direction of the maximum, sin theta, as a function of the product of the order and the wavelength, k lambda. Six black points: (410; 0.245), (434; 0.261), (486; 0.292), (656; 0.394), (972; 0.584) and (1313; 0.788), with the horizontal axis in nanometres. A straight line through the origin has been fitted to the points, and the point (1300 nm; 0.780) is marked on it. The gradient of the line is 6.00 times 10 to the power minus 4 per nanometre.
